scenario: A science-desk agent pipeline drafts a news article summarizing a newly published clinical trial. The pipeline extracts methodology and outcome data from the trial PDF, normalizes and interprets the statistical findings into plain-language takeaways, then produces a formatted news-article draft.
info_flow: mineru-pdf-extractor extracts the trial PDF to structured Markdown including tables and statistical results → summarize-pro converts the extracted content into Key Takeaways plain-language points → ub2-markdown-report-generator uses those takeaways to produce a formatted news-article report.
